question: Gandhiji, aged ______, arrived in India in 1915 from South Africa.
solution:
The correct answer is **46** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mahatma Gandhi was born on 2 Oct 1869.
 
• He returns to India from South Africa on 9 January 1915.
 
• At the time, Age of Mahatma Gandhi was 45 years 3 months and 7 days.
 
• After arriving in India, Mahatma Gandhi successfully organized Satyagraha Movements in various places.
 
• Gandhi returned to India from South Africa in 1915 at the request of Gopal Krishna Gokhale.
 
• Gandhi Ji returns from South Africa can be seen as perfect timing for the future of development of the Indian national movement. Gokhale helped Gandhiji at the time of hardships in raising funds when Gandhiji was in South Africa.
 
• Gokhale insisted Gandhiji that he has been far away from his nation. He wanted Gandhiji to come to India and know the situation of India under British Rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points:__**Things Mahatma Gandhi did in South Africa:

 
• He organised non-violent protests against the racial discrimination directed towards the native Africans and Indians in 1894.
 
• He came to India for a short time in 1896 to gather fellow India to serve in South Africa,
 
• He organised the Indian Ambulance corps for the British during the outbreak of the Boer War in 1899.
 
• Het set up Phoenix Farm near Durban where Gandhi trained his cadre for peaceful restraint or non-violent Satyagraha.
 
• He also set up another farm which was Tolstoy Farm which is considered the place where Satyagraha was moulded into a weapon of protest.

Movements Started by Gandhiji in India:

 
• Champaran Satyagraha of 1917
 
• Kheda Satyagrah of 1918
 
• Khilafat Movement Post World War I
 
• Non-Co-operation Movement
 
• Civil Disobedience Movement
 
• Negotiations over Round Table Conferences
 
• Gandhi Irwin Pact
 
• Quit India Movement
